Cost +2 Vitae

Range 30 feet

Area 15-foot burst, allies only

One Graft, the whole line, one breath.

When you apply a Graft's effect to a willing creature, you may instead apply it to every ally in a 15-foot burst centered on a point within 30 feet, at 2 additional Vitae cost. Grafts that would normally require an attack roll instead apply automatically to willing allies, since there is no attack being resisted.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element retargets a willing-creature Graft to a 15-ft ally-only burst -- same AoE-conversion issue as Chain Cut.
